name: Software feature
about: Propose a user-visible CLI, input, output, diagnostic, or workflow capability
title: "Feature: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## User Problem

Who needs this capability, and what are they currently unable to do easily?

## Proposed Behavior

Describe the desired behavior from the user's perspective.

## Example Interface

Show an example command, runfile fragment, input, output, or diagnostic when
applicable. This is a starting point for design, not a required implementation.

## Affected Area

- [ ] Command-line interface
- [ ] Runfile or configuration
- [ ] Input or output format
- [ ] Diagnostics
- [ ] Basis-set management
- [ ] Reporting
- [ ] Other user-facing workflow

## Compatibility and Errors

Describe compatibility expectations for existing commands and files, along with
the desired behavior for invalid or unsupported inputs.

## Current Alternatives

How can users accomplish this today, and why is that insufficient?

## Acceptance Criteria

What observable behavior, tests, and documentation would make this complete?

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched the existing issues and roadmap for related proposals.
- [ ] This proposal describes a user-visible capability rather than a scientific method or an internal refactor.
